findings.problem: Schema "formData" passed to superValidate() appears to be defined inside a function scope — Superforms v2 requires schemas at module top level to avoid re-creation on every request.
findings.suggestedFix: Move the formData schema definition to module top level (outside of any function/action/load).

findings.problem: Client calls superForm(data.form) but the server load() does not return a form object — data.form will be undefined.
findings.suggestedFix: In +page.server.ts load(), return { form: await superValidate(zod(schema)) }.

findings.problem: API route (UNKNOWN) reads request body via request.json()/formData() but does not validate it with Zod — untrusted input passes through unvalidated.
findings.suggestedFix: Import Zod schema and call schema.safeParse(body) before using the data. Return 400 on parse failure.
